info.title: TokenWatch Pricing API
info.description: Read-only, public JSON API for TokenWatch text, image, video, provider, organization, pricing catalog data, and workload-aware recommendations. Prices are USD per million tokens unless a response says otherwise, and every unknown value is null rather than zero. Responses are compact JSON (`pretty=1` to indent) and carry a strong `ETag`: send `If-None-Match` to get a bodyless 304. Successful GETs are cacheable for 300 seconds with a 600-second stale-while-revalidate window; errors are `no-store`. `HEAD` returns the same status and headers as `GET` without a body.

get.summary: Recommend models for a workload; chat and creative-writing also return an Arena preference favorite with source metadata
get.description: Open-weight model shortlist for one use case: picks.bestQuality, picks.bestValue (quality/price Pareto frontier) and picks.cheapestAboveFloor, each with a recommended provider, explanation, and confidence (stable, moderately_stable, close_call). Also returns alsoConsidered, partiallyBenchmarked, unbenchmarked, and unverified groups. Arena ratings in preference are from the LMArena leaderboard dataset (CC BY 4.0); display the attribution in preference.source.

parameters.name: use_case
parameters.description: Workload preset id. See `/api/v1/use-cases` for each preset's assumed mix, weights, requirements and quality floor.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Provider-ranking weights. `balanced` uses the use case defaults; the others re-weight price, time-to-first-token, throughput and uptime.

parameters.name: zdr
parameters.description: When `true`, only providers marked zero data retention are eligible.

parameters.name: exclude_hq
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 headquarters country codes to exclude. Providers with unknown headquarters are kept, not excluded. A code that is not a real country code is a 400.

parameters.name: include_proprietary
parameters.description: When `true`, also consider models not confirmed open-weight. Defaults to open-weight models only.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: `compact` returns summary rows with total counts; `full` adds explanations and per-provider detail to every returned row, which enlarges the payload by orders of magnitude.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows per recommendation group (1–100), or at most 25 with `detail=full`. An out-of-range value is a 400 rather than a clamp.

parameters.name: min_context
parameters.description: Keep offerings whose context window is at least this many tokens. Offerings with an unknown context window are excluded.

parameters.name: min_output
parameters.description: Keep offerings whose maximum completion tokens are at least this value. Unknown maximums are excluded.

parameters.name: min_intelligence
parameters.description: Keep offerings whose benchmark `intelligence_index` is at least this value (decimals allowed, e.g. `45.5`). Unbenchmarked offerings are excluded; `0` disables the filter. Negative or non-numeric values are a 400.

parameters.name: quantization
parameters.description: Exact quantization label such as `fp8`, `fp4`, `nvfp4`, `bf16` or `unknown`, matched case-insensitively.

parameters.name: open_weights
parameters.description: Keep offerings with a resolved open-weight status of `true` or `false`. Unknown statuses are excluded from both, and `null` matches neither.

parameters.name: cache_read
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only offerings that publish a cache-read tariff.

parameters.name: cache_write
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only offerings that publish a cache-write tariff.

parameters.name: promo
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only promotional offerings (`discount > 0`). A structural price has `discount: 0`.

parameters.name: zdr
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only offerings from a provider marked zero data retention.

parameters.name: sub
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only offerings available through a subscription plan.

parameters.name: benchmarked
parameters.description: When `true`, keep only offerings carrying a benchmark sidecar.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match across model id, display name, org and provider.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort key. Prices are USD per million tokens; `context`, `max_output` and `uptime` are offering metrics; `intelligence`, `coding` and `agentic` are benchmark indices. Null values sort last in both directions. An unknown key is a 400 listing the valid keys.

parameters.description: Sort direction, case-insensitive (`DESC` works). Any other value is a 400.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first row, a non-negative integer; anything else is a 400. An offset past the end returns an empty page with an honest `total`.

get.summary: List providers for one canonical model, ordered by cost

parameters.name: canonicalId
parameters.description: Canonical model id. Slashes (`org/model`), colons (`:batch`, `:flex`, `:priority`) and mixed case are accepted, and `%2F` percent-encoding works because the id may itself contain slashes.

parameters.name: tokens
parameters.description: Positive token count. It scales the cost figure only and never changes the order; zero, negative or non-numeric values are a 400.

parameters.name: mix
parameters.description: Comma-separated input, cached-input, output percentages used to blend each offering's rates. Must sum to 100, validated like `/history`. When present, offerings sort by the blended rate at this mix with unpriceable offerings last; `tokens` is not required. Without it, offerings sort by `input + output`, unpriced offerings last.

get.summary: Per-provider cost for a model at a token count and mix, cheapest first
get.description: Returns { provider, provider_display, quantization, rate_per_mtok, cost_usd } for every offering of one canonical model, sorted cheapest first. Offerings that cannot be priced at the requested mix return cost_usd: null with an unpriceable_reason and are listed last — never $0. Pricing.description: Published tariffs in USD per million tokens. A null value is unknown, not free.

input.description: Uncached input price per million tokens.

cache_read.description: Cached-input read price per million tokens; null when unpublished.

cache_write.description: Cache-write price per million tokens; null when unpublished.

cache_write_addon.description: Extra cache-storage charge when the provider bills one.

input_billing.description: When "cache_write", fresh input is billed at the write tariff.

ContextPriceTier.description: Long-context tariff applying to a single request above `above_tokens`. The base `pricing` still governs the default calculator estimate.

SupportedParameterValue.description: Acceptable values for one request parameter: `{type:"boolean"}`, `{type:"enum",values:[…]}` or `{type:"range",min,max}`; `true`/`false` for plain flags.

ModelsDev.description: models.dev enrichment for this (provider, model) pair. Null when no match was found. Enrichment fills gaps; it never overwrites a source price.

confidence.description: Exact match (`high`) or bounded fuzzy match (`medium`).

items.description: One reasoning control models.dev reports for the model. An empty array means none are listed.

ModelsDevModel.description: Model-level models.dev fallback, used only when no provider-specific block matched.

items.description: One reasoning control models.dev reports for the model. An empty array means none are listed.

Benchmarks.description: Benchmark sidecar. Any individual score is null when that benchmark did not cover the model.

Model.description: One text-generation offering: a model sold by one provider.

id.description: Model identifier as published by the source. May contain `/`, `:` (delivery variant) or mixed case.

org.description: Lowercase organization slug owning the model.

discount.description: Promotional fraction off the provider list price. 0 means a structural price, not a promo.

zdr.description: True when the provider is marked zero data retention.

subscription.description: True when the offering is sold through a subscription plan.

open_weights.description: Resolved weight availability. Null means unknown, never "closed".

license.description: Source-cited license when reviewed, otherwise the models.dev or provider-catalog license.

supports_tool_choice.description: True when at least one tool_choice value is supported.

supports_implicit_caching.description: True when the provider caches prompts implicitly.

lifecycle_status.description: models.dev lifecycle status. Deprecated offerings are never recommended.

context_price_tiers.description: Long-context tiers, ascending by `above_tokens`; null when the base tariff applies to every context length.

ProviderOffering.description: One provider selling one canonical model, with the capability and cost fields the recommender consumes.

zdr.description: Always a boolean here; false when not confirmed.

HistoryPoint.description: Cheapest priceable offering for one UTC day at the requested mix. Days nothing can be priced are omitted, never emitted as zero.

model_id.description: Model id as stored in the snapshot, which can differ in case from the request.

blended.description: Blended USD per million tokens at the requested mix.

HistoryOffering.description: Every priceable offering for that day, so a chart can show a provider switch without a second request.

HistoryResponse.description: At most 90 chronological daily points (oldest → newest). `points[i]` is the cheapest entry of `series[i].offerings`.

canonical_id.description: Normalized model id actually looked up, which strips the org prefix and version suffixes.

from.description: First day of the requested window (inclusive).

to.description: Last day of the requested window, always today in UTC.

mix.description: Mix used to blend the stored raw tariffs.

point_count.description: Number of returned days; fewer than `days` when snapshots are missing.

provider_switches.description: Times the cheapest provider changed between consecutive points.

Mix.description: Assumed workload mix in percent. These are documented defaults, not measurements of your traffic.

Confidence.description: How stable a pick is against the runner-up. `uncompared` means there was no comparable alternative.

QualityFloor.description: Absolute quality floor a model must clear to be ranked at all.

field.description: Benchmark field the floor applies to, e.g. `coding_index`.

OfferingSummary.description: Compact offering attached to a recommendation pick.

RecommendProvider.description: A ranked provider for one model at the use case mix.

score.description: Composite provider score (0-100) at the priority weights.

blendedRate.description: USD per million tokens at the use case mix.

ttftP50.description: Median time to first token in seconds.

uptimeWindow.description: Window the uptime figure covers, e.g. `30m`.

reasons.description: Why this provider ranked where it did.

unknowns.description: Missing signals that weakened the score.

explanation.description: Present on the top three and on `detail=full` rows only.

UnverifiedProvider.description: A provider missing required capability or context metadata. Never ranked.

Recommendation.description: One model pick. Compact rows carry scores, rates and a single reason; `detail=full` adds explanations.

qualityScore.description: Use-case-weighted benchmark score (0-100) after shrinking uncovered weights toward the cohort median.

qualityCoverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the use-case benchmark weight actually covered.

blendedRate.description: Cheapest blended rate across eligible providers.

recommendedBlendedRate.description: Blended rate of the recommended provider.

RecommendationRow.description: Compact row used by the alsoConsidered / partiallyBenchmarked / unbenchmarked / unverified groups.

Group.description: A candidate group. `totalCount` counts every member; `items` is capped at `limit`.

ProviderGroup.description: Ranked provider group. `totalCount` counts every ranked provider; `items` is capped at `limit`, with full explanations on the top three or on every row for `detail=full`.

PreferenceSource.description: Dataset metadata for the Arena ratings. Consumers must display this attribution: it is licensed CC BY 4.0.

Preference.description: Arena favorite shown separately from the capability-ranked picks. Returned for `chat-assistant` and `creative-writing`; null for other use cases.

field.description: Benchmark field the favorite comes from, e.g. `arena_text`.

RecommendResponse.description: Workload-aware shortlist. Picks are open-weight by default; `include_proprietary=true` also admits models not confirmed open-weight. Groups are compact unless `detail=full`.
